handling.NORMAL: candidate evidence may be evaluated within declared scope
handling.SENSITIVE: minimize references and preserve access scope
handling.HIGH_SENSITIVITY: strong provenance and explicit review metadata required
handling.USER_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: hold candidate until explicit user review path
handling.DO_NOT_GENERALIZE: retain local candidate only; no cross-context promotion
handling.DO_NOT_PERSIST_CANDIDATE: candidate remains non-persistent and nullable downstream
